Fourteen days after injecting mice with this toxin, he isolates antibodies against neutrophil proteinase 3 in their sera. A patient with high concentrations of these antibodies would most likely present with which of the following clinical features?

opd. Migratory thrombophlebitis and digital ulcers
ope. Genital ulcers and anterior uveitis
